breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal torque as uniform over the whole shaft, even though applied torques at intermediate locations make the internal torque piecewise constant.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly treats the internal torque as piecewise constant by dividing the shaft into two segments (Segment 1: x=0 to x=400 mm, Segment 2: x=400 mm to x=1200 mm) and specifying that each segment has its own constant internal torque calculated separately. This directly contradicts the flawed instruction in the incomplete prompt that said to 'take a single internal torque equal to the algebraic sum of the applied torques over the full length,' and instead aligns with the ground truth approach of analyzing each segment independently.
